name: BMad Method
description: AI-driven agile development framework — the BMad Method as an OpenClaw plugin. Installs the official, always-current bmad-method skill catalog per-project and registers agent tools for skill dispatch and state tracking.

bmadVersion.description: npm dist-tag or exact version of bmad-method to install for new projects (e.g. "latest", "next", "6.11.0"). Defaults to "latest".
